text:
Carter Mazur is a Jackson, Michigan kid playing for the Red Wings, and lately he's been playing more. After weeks of six to ten minutes a night, he got 13.6 minutes in Florida on Nov. 12 and 14.7 in the 2-0 win in Tampa two days later. He has 1 goal and 5 points in 14 games, after going without a point in nine NHL games before this season.

The trouble is what happens with him on the ice. At five on five Detroit has taken only 37% of the expected goals during his shifts, about 16 points worse than when he sits, over a small sample. Only 38% of his even-strength time comes in the offensive zone, and that's where his game has to tilt.

He's fast, with a top speed in the top 5% of the league, and the 2021 third-round pick scored 37 points in 60 AHL games two seasons ago. If his minutes keep climbing, the question is whether the shot share comes up with them.
